issue_context.title: URL: URL.revokeObjectURL accepts no parameters when 1 is required
issue_context.body:
### Version

n/a

### Platform

n/a

### Subsystem

url

### What steps will reproduce the bug?

```js
URL.revokeObjectURL()
```

### How often does it reproduce? Is there a required condition?

_No response_

### What is the expected behavior? Why is that the expected behavior?

this should throw a TypeError

### What do you see instead?

`undefined`

### Additional information

https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/3c1b4b364e964e28d1f8dc32c9a50bcb7d6a8f41/lib/internal/url.js#L1106-L1108

a check is needed along the lines of

https://github.com/nodejs/node/blob/3c1b4b364e964e28d1f8dc32c9a50bcb7d6a8f41/lib/internal/url.js#L772-L774
comments: Why does it need to throw an error?
Because the parameter is not defined as optional.

relevant part of the webidl spec:

An argument is considered to be an optional argument if it is declared with the optional keyword. The final argument of a [variadic](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-variadic) operation is also considered to be an optional argument. Declaring an argument to be optional indicates that the argument value can be omitted when the operation is invoked. The final argument in an operation must not explicitly be declared to be optional if the operation is [variadic](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-variadic).

Optional arguments can also have a default value specified. If the argument’s identifier is followed by a U+003D (=) and a value (matching [DefaultValue](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#prod-DefaultValue)), then that gives the optional argument its [default value](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-optional-argument-default-value). The implicitly optional final argument of a [variadic](https://webidl.spec.whatwg.org/#dfn-variadic) operation must not have a default value specified. The default value is the value to be assumed when the operation is called with the corresponding argument omitted.
